submittedArguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 1 is the exact local layout: repaint its existing shapes with crisp native detail; its blur is only a coordinate guide, never final pixels. Image 2 is the north native strip matching the top 230 pixels. Image 3 is the west native strip matching the left 230 pixels. Preserve the positions, surface transitions and edge geometry of both strips; do not stretch, resize or invent forms. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Open pale warm golden sand and sparse tiny pebbles occupy almost all this patch. Retain the soft sand shading entering from the left midway down. At the extreme bottom near x=650..850, retain only the small pale foam/light-cyan shoreline sliver visible in image 1; keep it confined to the cropped lower edge, without extending water upward into the sand. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. No added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
